title: Legacy to Cloud Infrastructure Migration
description: Migrate to the cloud at ease, retaining data & encryption control. Fortanix simplifies multicloud key management, modernizes HSMs & ensures compliance.
markdown:
# Migrate to Cloud with Confidence

Migrate workloads to the cloud without losing the control you have in the data center. Fortanix enables the ultimate data and encryption key sovereignty, with all the agility the cloud has to offer. Tokenize regulated data, and keep custody of your keys using external key management (EKM/XKS), Hold Your Own Key  (HYOK).

[![Request a Demo](https://no-cache.hubspot.com/cta/default/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5.png)](https://cta-redirect.hubspot.com/cta/redirect/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5)

![FORT Cloud Migration Header](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fsolutions%2Fuse-case%2Flegacy-to-cloud-infrastructure-migration%2FFORT_Cloud_Migration_Header.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Reduce Complexity with Multicloud Key Management

Consolidate your cloud key management services and modernize legacy encryption keys on Fortanix. The platform automatically discovers at-risk keys so you can remediate them based on their priority level, bringing them into a multicloud infrastructure alongside keys from AWS, Google and more.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/solutions/enterprise-key-management/multicloud-key-management)

![FORT_CloudMigration_Feature_2](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fsolutions%2Fuse-case%2Flegacy-to-cloud-infrastructure-migration%2FFORT_CloudMigration_Feature_2.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Govern Consistent Compliance Policies

Simplify the governance of security policies across the silos in your enterprise infrastructure. Fortanix provides centralized controls for controlling access to sensitive data, administrative guardrails, and continuous monitoring of your cryptographic security posture.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/solutions/compliance)

![ FORT_CloudMigration_Feature_3](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fsolutions%2Fuse-case%2Flegacy-to-cloud-infrastructure-migration%2FFORT_CloudMigration_Feature_3.webp&w=3840&q=75)

## Modernize Legacy HSMs

Easily transition to modern HSM infrastructure. Deploy the Fortanix HSM Gateway to seamlessly move between on-premises and public cloud infrastructures with a single consistent set of cryptographic services and keys. Upgrade your stack with modern, scalable FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM, available on-prem or as SaaS.

![ Modernize Legacy HSMs](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/solutions/use-case/legacy-to-cloud-infrastructure-migration/Modernize_Legacy_HSMs.webp)

![Encrypt](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/solutions/use-case/legacy-to-cloud-infrastructure-migration/Encrypt.svg)

###### HSM Modernization

Enable a seamless transition to modern HSM infrastructure made for DevOps automation. Bridge the silos of your existing legacy HSMs, deploying them alongside our scalable, FIPS-validated HSMs with the Fortanix HSM gateway. The Fortanix Data Security manager consolidates all HSMs into a single, easy-to-manage solution.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager/hsm-modernization)

![Visibility](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/solutions/use-case/legacy-to-cloud-infrastructure-migration/Visibility.svg)

###### Activate New, Compliant HSMs in Minutes

As you phase out legacy infrastructure, use the Fortanix Data Security Manager to provision and manage HSMs in a fraction of the time it would take on your own. All of Fortanix’s HSMs are FIPS 140-2 level 3 validated and available on-prem or in the cloud.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager/hardware-security-module)
